name: Moneybird
description: Moneybird — Dutch online bookkeeping for freelancers and small companies: contacts, sales invoices, purchase invoices, estimates, products and financial mutations. REST API v2, bearer token.
instructions:
**Getting a token**
1. Sign in to Moneybird and open **Instellingen → Koppelingen → API-tokens** (Settings → Integrations → API tokens).
2. Create a personal access token and put it in `MONEYBIRD_API_TOKEN`.
3. Set `MONEYBIRD_ADMINISTRATION_ID` to the numeric administration id. It is in the URL when you are logged in — `moneybird.com/123456789/…` — and `moneybird_list_administrations` also returns it.

**Every data path carries the administration id.** A Moneybird account can hold several administrations (one per company, or a bookkeeper's client list) and each has its own id. This connector is fixed to one; add a second connector for a second administration.

**Rate limit**: roughly 150 requests per five minutes per token, and Moneybird answers a burst with 429 plus a `Retry-After`. Pace bulk work rather than retrying immediately.

**Filtering is a single comma-separated string**, not repeated parameters: `filter=period:this_year,state:open`. Available keys differ per resource — for sales invoices the useful ones are `period`, `state` (`all`, `draft`, `open`, `scheduled`, `pending_payment`, `late`, `reminded`, `paid`, `uncollectible`; combine with a pipe, e.g. `state:open|late`) and `contact_id`. A filter you pass replaces the defaults entirely (`period:this_year`, `state:all`), so include `period` when you need anything outside the current year.

**Paging** is `page` (1-based) and `per_page` (max 100). There is no total count in the body; a short page means you have reached the end. Financial mutations are the exception: that endpoint has no paging and returns at most 100 rows, so narrow it with `period` (e.g. `period:20260101..20260131`).

**Amounts are strings in euros**, and `total_price_incl_tax` is not `total_price_excl_tax`. Pick the one the question actually means.

**Cloud reachability**: moneybird.com is public with a valid certificate.

tools.name: moneybird_list_administrations
tools.description: List the administrations this token can reach, with their id, name, language and currency. The one call that needs no administration id.

tools.name: moneybird_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts — customers and suppliers — with their company name, contact person, address, VAT number and customer id.

query.description: Search fragment matched against name, e-mail and customer id.

tools.name: moneybird_get_contact
tools.description: Read one contact in full: addresses, tax identifiers, payment terms, custom fields and the notes recorded against them.

tools.name: moneybird_list_sales_invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices with their number, date, due date, contact, totals and state. Filter with `state:open` or `state:late` for the receivables question.

filter.description: Comma-separated filter, e.g. period:this_year,state:open. States: all, draft, open, scheduled, pending_payment, late, reminded, paid, uncollectible (pipe to combine, e.g. state:open|late). A filter replaces the defaults (period:this_year, state:all).

tools.name: moneybird_get_sales_invoice
tools.description: Read one sales invoice in full: every detail line with quantity, price and tax rate, the totals, the payment schedule and the payments received.

tools.name: moneybird_list_purchase_invoices
tools.description: List purchase invoices and receipts with their supplier, date, due date and total — the cost side of the ledger.

tools.name: moneybird_list_estimates
tools.description: List estimates (offertes) with their number, date, contact, total and state, to see what is out with customers and not yet won.

tools.name: moneybird_list_products
tools.description: List the products and services in the catalogue with their description, price, tax rate and ledger account.

tools.name: moneybird_list_financial_mutations
tools.description: List bank mutations with their date, amount, description and reconciliation state, so unpaid invoices can be matched against money that actually arrived. Returns at most 100 rows and has no paging: narrow the period instead.

filter.description: Comma-separated filter, e.g. period:this_month or period:20260101..20260131,state:unprocessed. Keys: period, state (all, unprocessed, processed, auto_booked), mutation_type (all, debit, credit), financial_account_id, amount_from, amount_to. Default period is this_year.
